svg.title: Proteome allocation and the rate-yield tradeoff
svg.desc: Two panels. On the left, the bacterial growth law. The share of the proteome given to ribosomes rises in a straight line with growth rate, and the share left for catabolic enzymes falls by the same amount. On the right, the tradeoff this implies between growth rate and yield, with two pools of strains marked on it. One pool sits in a narrow band of the axis and the other spans it, which is the contrast the research question turns on.
